task: Fix Pocket Studio play button / video playback after import
resume_brief: Fixed three playback bugs in ~/workspace/pocket-studio-v2/app.html: (1) importVideoFile() now sets video.src via blob URL IMMEDIATELY before awaiting the IndexedDB save, so a slow 25MB IDB write on mobile no longer blocks video loading; (2) fixed undeclared `drag` variable in two spots (timeupdate listener line ~1677 and 120ms sync interval line ~3322) changed to `gesture` — this was throwing ReferenceError on every playback tick; (3) play button and tap-to-play togglePlay() now catch video.play() promise rejections with user feedback instead of silent failure. Verified with node --check (both inline scripts pass). Triggered artifact.edit rebuild on pocket-studio-v2.
